scripts.lint:python: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pylint app run.py tests; else python3 -m pylint app run.py tests; fi
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:python
scripts.quality: npm run test:coverage && npm run lint:all
scripts.test:coverage: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=98; else python3 -m pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=98; fi
scripts.test: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q; else python3 -m pytest -q; fi
